models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_channels
models.description:
Discussion board channels that organize content into distinct categories.

Channels serve as the primary organizational structure for the discussion board,
providing users with clear categories to navigate and participate in discussions.
Each channel represents a specific topic or theme that users can explore and
contribute to. Channels can contain multiple sections, which further organize
the content within the channel.

The channel entity is a primary entity that users interact with directly,
requiring independent management capabilities. This includes the ability to
create, edit, and delete channels, as well as view and search across all
channels.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: The name of the channel, which is displayed to users and used for identification purposes.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: A detailed description of the channel's purpose and content, helping users understand what the channel is about.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the channel was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the channel was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the channel was deleted, if applicable.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_sections
models.description:
Sections within channels that further organize content into subcategories.

Sections provide an additional layer of organization within channels, allowing for
the grouping of related content. Each section represents a specific subtopic or
aspect of the channel's main theme. Sections can contain multiple articles,
which are the primary content items within the discussion board.

The section entity is a primary entity that users interact with directly,
requiring independent management capabilities. This includes the ability to
create, edit, and delete sections, as well as view and search across all
sections within a channel.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_channel_id
foreignFields.description: The channel that this section belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_channels.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: The name of the section, which is displayed to users and used for identification purposes.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: A detailed description of the section's purpose and content, helping users understand what the section is about.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the section was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the section was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the section was deleted, if applicable.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_configurations
models.description:
Configuration settings for the discussion board that control its behavior and appearance.

Configurations provide administrators with the ability to customize the
appearance and behavior of the discussion board. These settings can include
options such as the default theme, the number of items to display per page,
and the rules for user participation.

The configuration entity is a primary entity that administrators interact with
directly, requiring independent management capabilities. This includes the
ability to create, edit, and delete configurations, as well as view and search
across all configurations.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: The unique identifier for the configuration setting, used to reference the setting in the application code.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: The value of the configuration setting, which can be a string, number, or boolean.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: A detailed description of the configuration setting, explaining its purpose and how it affects the discussion board.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the configuration setting was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the configuration setting was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when the configuration setting was deleted, if applicable.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_guests
models.description:
Guest users who can view articles and comments but cannot create or edit content.

Guests are unauthenticated users who can only view public content on the discussion board. They do not have the ability to create articles, comments, or attachments. Guest users are identified by their IP address and session information, which is stored in the guest_sessions table.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest user.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was soft deleted.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_guest_sessions
models.description:
Session records for guest users.

Session records store information about the guest user's session, including the IP address, connection URL, and referrer URL. This information is used to track the guest user's activity on the discussion board and to ensure that the guest user's session is valid.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Guest user associated with this session. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_guests.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest user.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL of the guest user.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL of the guest user.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session record was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session record expired.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_members
models.description:
Registered members who can create, edit, and delete their own articles and comments.

Members are authenticated users who have registered on the discussion board. They have the ability to create, edit, and delete their own articles and comments. Member users are identified by their username, email address, and password hash, which is stored securely in the database.

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: Username of the member user.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address of the member user.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure hash of the member user's password.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member record was soft deleted.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_member_sessions
models.description:
Session records for member users.

Session records store information about the member user's session, including the IP address, connection URL, and referrer URL. This information is used to track the member user's activity on the discussion board and to ensure that the member user's session is valid.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member user associated with this session. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: ip

plainFields.name: href

plainFields.name: referrer

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: expired_at

models.description:
Moderators who can manage all articles, comments, and user accounts.

Moderators are authenticated users who have administrative privileges on the discussion board. They have the ability to manage all articles, comments, and user accounts. Moderator users are identified by their username, email address, and password hash, which is stored securely in the database.

models.description:
Session records for moderator users.

Session records store information about the moderator user's session, including the IP address, connection URL, and referrer URL. This information is used to track the moderator user's activity on the discussion board and to ensure that the moderator user's session is valid.

foreignFields.description: Moderator user associated with this session. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_moderators.id}

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_articles
models.description:
Main article entity for economic/political discussion board.

Contains shared fields for all articles including title, content, and
creation metadata. The actor_type field indicates which user type created
the article (member or moderator).

Articles can have multiple attachments through the
{@link economic_political_discussion_board_attachment_of_articles}
relationship. Comments are associated through the
{@link economic_political_discussion_board_comments} relationship.

Each article is associated with a channel and section for
categorization. Historical versions are tracked through the
{@link economic_political_discussion_board_article_snapshots}
relationship.

Soft deletion is supported through the deleted_at field to allow
content recovery while maintaining audit trails.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel this article belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_channels.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_section_id
foreignFields.description: Section this article belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_sections.id}

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who created this article. Either 'member' or 'moderator'.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the article.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Main content of the article.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this article was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this article was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this article was soft-deleted (null if active).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_of_members
models.description:
Tracks articles created by members.

Contains member-specific information about articles created by regular
members. Each record links to a specific article and member, recording
the member's session at creation time.

This table establishes the 1:1 relationship between articles and the
members who created them, while the main article table tracks the
shared article data.

The combination of article_id and member_id is unique to ensure
each article is associated with exactly one member.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Article created by this member. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who created this article. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_member_session_id
foreignFields.description: Session used when this article was created. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_member_sessions.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this article was created by the member.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_of_moderators
models.description:
Tracks articles created by moderators.

Contains moderator-specific information about articles created by
moderators. Each record links to a specific article and moderator,
recording the moderator's session at creation time.

This table establishes the 1:1 relationship between articles and the
moderators who created them, while the main article table tracks the
shared article data.

The combination of article_id and moderator_id is unique to ensure
each article is associated with exactly one moderator.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Article created by this moderator. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator who created this article. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_moderators.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_moderator_session_id
foreignFields.description: Session used when this article was created. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_moderator_sessions.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this article was created by the moderator.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_snapshots
models.description:
Historical versions of articles for audit trail.

Captures point-in-time states of articles for historical tracking and
audit purposes. Each snapshot records the complete state of an article
at a specific point in time, including all shared fields from the main
article table.

Snapshots are created whenever an article is created, updated,
or deleted. This allows for complete reconstruction of an article's
lifecycle and provides a complete audit trail of all changes.

The relationship to the main article table allows tracking all versions
of each article, while the created_at field records when each snapshot
was taken.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Article this snapshot belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_articles.id}

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who created this article. Either 'member' or 'moderator'.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the article at this snapshot.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Content of the article at this snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot was taken.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this article was last updated at this snapshot.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this article was soft-deleted at this snapshot (null if active).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_actors
models.description:
Tracks articles created by members or moderators.

Contains actor-specific information about articles created by members or
moderators. Each record links to a specific article and actor, recording
the actor's session at creation time.

This table establishes the 1:1 relationship between articles and the
actors who created them, while the main article table tracks the
shared article data.

The combination of article_id and actor_id is unique to ensure
each article is associated with exactly one actor.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Article created by this actor. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: Actor who created this article. Either a member or moderator.

foreignFields.name: actor_session_id
foreignFields.description: Session used when this article was created. Either a member session or moderator session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this article was created by the actor.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_comments
models.description:
Main entity for storing comments on articles in the economic/political discussion board.

This table serves as the central repository for all user comments, capturing the core content and metadata for each comment. It establishes the foundational structure for the comment system by tracking the relationship between comments and articles, as well as identifying the type of user who created the comment.

The comment content includes a title and body for structured communication, and it maintains temporal information for auditing purposes. Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing content moderation.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: The article that this comment belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_articles.id}

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of user who created the comment. Valid values: 'member' or 'moderator'.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the comment.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Content of the comment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the comment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the comment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the comment was deleted (soft delete).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_comment_of_members
models.description:
Subtype entity for storing member-specific information about comments.

This table captures member-specific details for comments created by registered members. It maintains the relationship between comments and the member who created them, including the member's session information for audit purposes.

The table ensures that only members can create comments, and it tracks the specific member session that was active when the comment was created.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: The comment that this record extends. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_comments.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member who created the comment. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_member_session_id
foreignFields.description: The session that was active when the comment was created. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_member_sessions.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the comment was created by the member.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_comment_of_moderators
models.description:
Subtype entity for storing moderator-specific information about comments.

This table captures moderator-specific details for comments created by moderators. It maintains the relationship between comments and the moderator who created them, including the moderator's session information for audit purposes.

The table ensures that only moderators can create comments, and it tracks the specific moderator session that was active when the comment was created.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: The comment that this record extends. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_comments.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: The moderator who created the comment. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_moderators.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_moderator_session_id
foreignFields.description: The session that was active when the comment was created. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_moderator_sessions.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the comment was created by the moderator.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_attachments
models.description:
Main attachment entity containing shared fields for all attachments.

Stores core attachment information including file metadata, upload timestamps,
and system management fields. This is the primary entity that users interact
with when managing attachments across the system.

Attachments can be associated with either articles or comments through
subtype entities, creating a polymorphic relationship pattern.

The main entity contains shared fields like file name, size, and MIME type,
while subtype entities track which specific content type each attachment belongs
to. This structure allows for proper data integrity while supporting
the different content types that can have attachments.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who created the attachment (e.g., 'member', 'moderator').

plainFields.name: file_name
plainFields.description: Original name of the uploaded file.

plainFields.name: file_size
plainFields.description: Size of the file in bytes.

plainFields.name: mime_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., 'image/jpeg', 'application/pdf').

plainFields.name: file_path
plainFields.description: Storage path of the file in the system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was deleted (soft delete).

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_attachment_of_articles
models.description:
Subtype entity tracking attachments associated with articles.

This table establishes the relationship between attachments and articles,
allowing articles to have multiple attachments while maintaining proper
data integrity. Each record links an attachment to a specific article and
includes the actor who created the attachment.

The subtype pattern ensures that attachments can be properly associated
with articles while maintaining the polymorphic relationship structure
with other content types.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_attachment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the main attachment entity. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_attachments.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the article this attachment belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_articles.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attachment-article relationship was created.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_attachment_of_comments
models.description:
Subtype entity tracking attachments associated with comments.

This table establishes the relationship between attachments and comments,
allowing comments to have multiple attachments while maintaining proper
data integrity. Each record links an attachment to a specific comment and
includes the actor who created the attachment.

The subtype pattern ensures that attachments can be properly associated
with comments while maintaining the polymorphic relationship structure
with other content types.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_attachment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the main attachment entity. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_attachments.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the comment this attachment belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_comments.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attachment-comment relationship was created.
